errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

breathing.description: Box breathing guide: breathe in for four seconds, hold for four, breathe out for four, hold for four.
breathing.caption: Try it now. Box breathing, four seconds each.

hero.title: Check in with yourself, privately.
hero.subtitle: Validated wellbeing check-ins, a companion that listens, and real help when you need it. No sign-up needed.

honest.title: Clear about what this is.
is: A self-check using the PHQ-9 and GAD-7, two questionnaires used by doctors worldwide.
A chat companion that adjusts its tone to how you're feeling.
A mood tracker with trends and a summary you can download.
A toolkit for breathing, grounding, journaling and mindfulness.
A safety net that connects you to real people, fast.
not: A diagnosis. Scores describe how you've been feeling, nothing more.
A therapist or an emergency service. It points you to both.
Watching you. Every data source stays off until you switch it on, and you can delete it.

how.title: Start with a few questions. The rest is up to you.

answer.title: Answer
answer.body: Nine questions about the last two weeks. It takes about three minutes.

talk.title: Talk
talk.body: Chat, or record a short voice note, if you want to. Both are optional.

connect.title: Connect
connect.body: Import sleep and step data from a file. Optional too.

review.title: Review
review.body: See your scores, your patterns, and next steps that fit.

how.sampleLead: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
how.sampleItem: Little interest or pleasure in doing things

anon.title: Anonymous by default
anon.body: No name, email or phone number needed to begin.

encrypted.title: Encrypted at rest
encrypted.body: Chat messages, journal entries and notes are encrypted before they are stored.

off.title: Off until you say yes
off.body: Voice, health data, reminders and cloud AI each need their own separate yes.

erase.title: Export or delete, anytime
erase.body: Download everything you've saved, or erase your account for good.

help.title: If you are not safe right now
help.body: Please reach a person now. These lines are free and open 24 hours a day.

final.title: Ready when you are.
final.body: It takes about three minutes, and you can stop at any point.

footer.disclaimer: MindGuard AI is a screening and support tool. It does not diagnose, and it is not an emergency service.
footer.made: Built for students and young adults in India.

age.title: Before we begin
age.question: Are you 18 or older?
age.why: MindGuard is designed for adults. We ask so we can point younger people to support made for them.

under18.title: Thank you for telling us.
under18.body: MindGuard is built for adults for now, so we can't set up an account for you. You still deserve support, and these people are ready to help.
under18.telemanas: Tele-MANAS is free, open 24x7, and talks with people of any age.
under18.trusted: A parent, teacher, school counsellor or another adult you trust is a good person to talk to.

consent.title: Choose what MindGuard can use
consent.intro: Only the first item is needed. Everything else stays off unless you switch it on, and you can change your mind anytime in Privacy.
consent.mustAgree: Please switch on the first item to continue.

core.label: Store my check-in answers and scores
core.body: Needed to show your results and trends. Stored against an anonymous ID, not your name.

chat_history.label: Keep chat history
chat_history.body: Save conversations for 30 days so you can come back to them. When off, each chat ends when you close it.

voice.label: Voice check-ins
voice.body: Analyse short voice notes for tone. Audio is processed in memory and never saved.

wearables.label: Health data import
wearables.body: Use sleep, steps and resting heart rate from files you upload.

cloud_llm.label: Cloud AI replies
cloud_llm.body: Allow a cloud AI service to write chat replies. Names, phone numbers and emails are removed first.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.body: Gentle notifications on this device to check in or take a breath.

login.title: Welcome back
login.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.

home.anonBody: Your data is tied to this browser. Add an email and password to keep it if you switch devices or clear your browser.
home.breatheBody: One round of box breathing takes sixteen seconds.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: See and change what MindGuard can use. Changes take effect straight away.
privacyPage.saveError: Couldn't save that change. Please try again.
privacyPage.upgradeIntro: Add an email and password so you can sign in on any device. Everything you've saved stays with you.
privacyPage.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short phrase works well.
privacyPage.upgraded: Your account is saved. You can now sign in with {{email}}.
privacyPage.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
privacyPage.invalid: Please check your email and use a password of at least 10 characters.
